Hi Claire — thanks again for the discovery call today. Great to hear about Novus Health's pilot goals and the three internal use cases you prioritized (clinical summarization, patient messaging, and search enrichment). Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that lays out milestones, owners, dependencies, and two target close windows.

High-level ask:
- Please review the MAP (attached) for accuracy on the milestones and owners I assigned.
- Confirm the correct stakeholder roster (I guessed product, security, and procurement contacts).
- Pick which close window you prefer: Fast (6–8 weeks) or Staged (12–14 weeks).

Key dependencies called out in the MAP:
- Security questionnaire completion (you noted SOC 2 in discovery)
- Test data access for the clinical summarization pilot
- Procurement SOW & PO (procurement team)

Attachments: Novus_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP table, milestones, owners, target close windows) and Novus_Retention_Notes.pdf (notes on data retention options).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm stakeholders and preferred close window (by end of this week)
2) We route the security questionnaire to your security lead (if different from the names below)
3) Align on pilot data scope and delivery method

If useful, I can propose calendar slots for a 30-minute MAP walk-through with your team next week.

Thanks,
